## Risk

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, lint, types, tests, and build pass.
- [ ] Tenant-boundary tests cover new data access.
- [ ] User-visible behavior was checked at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] Migrations are backward compatible and have a rollback/roll-forward plan.
- [ ] Logs, metrics, alerts, runbooks, and feature flags are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or production identifiers are included.

## Deployment

State the progressive rollout, monitoring signals, and rollback threshold.
